 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Mohit Kumar Shah
Oral Order

2 11-05-2023 The present writ petition has been filed seeking the following reliefs:-
"1.(A) A writ in the nature of Certiorari or any other appropriate writ/s, order/s,
direction/s quashing the following:
I.

Show-cause notice dated 30.07.2022 issued by the Circle Officer, Sampatchak under Section 3 of Bihar Public Land Encroachment Act, 1956, whereby, Respondent No. 6 had Patna High Court CWJC No.14922 of 2022(2) dt.11-05-2023 alleged that the Petitioner has encroached an area of 952 sq. ft. pertaining to KhataNo. 899 Khesra No. 457 situated at Thana- Gopalpur,Village Post- Bairiya, Patna and had asked the Petitioner to appear before him on 05.08.2022 to explain the reasons as to Awadh Kishor vs The State Of Bihar on 11 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12293477/
1 why the encroachment would not be removed.

entities.text: Awadh Kishor vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
(B)A writ in the nature of mandamus or any other appropriate writ/s, order/s, direction/s for the following reliefs:
I. To declare the demolition of property/building/house of the Petitioner pertaining to Khata No. 899 Khesra No. 457 situated at Thana- Gopalpur, Post- Bairiya, Village Bairiya, District-Patna, Bihar to be illegal and bad in law.

II. To direct the Respondent Authorities to restore the possession of the land/property of the Petitioner pertaining to Khata No. 899 Khesra No. 457 situated at Thana Gopalpur, Post- Bairiya, Village- Bairiya, District- Patna, Bihar in favour of the Petitioner.

III. To direct the respondent authorities Patna High Court CWJC No.14922 of 2022(2) dt.11-05-2023 to produce all the documents related to land acquisition proceeding and encroachment proceedings, if any, done against the land/property of the Petitioner.
IV. To direct for payment of compensation to the Petitioner if it is found that his land/property has been demolished without proper acquisition or encroachment proceedings.

V. To take appropriate actions against the erring respondents for committing misdeeds, misdemeanour and illegality,
particularly for keeping the petitioner in mental distress and harassment."

At the outset, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks not to press the present writ petition,
however, seeks liberty on behalf of the petitioner to avail such other alternative remedies as are otherwise available under the law, for redressal of the aforesaid grievances.
Liberty so sought is granted.
The writ petition stands dismissed as not pressed.

At this juncture, the learned counsel for Patna High Court CWJC No.14922 of 2022(2)
dt.11-05-2023 the petitioner submits that the respondent-State be directed to supply a certified copy of the final order passed by the Circle Officer, Sampatchak in connection with Encroachment Case No. 07 of 2022-23.
It is directed accordingly.
The writ petition stands disposed off as not pressed.

(Mohit Kumar Shah, J) S.Sb/sonal- U Awadh Kishor vs The State Of Bihar on 11 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12293477/
